changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwwaseelsbsimportlog AS SELECT wsil.id, wsil.file_name, wsil.total_rows, wsil.success_rows, wsil.failed_rows, wsil.error_details, wsil.created_date, wsil.created_by, wsil.last_modified_by, wsil.last_modified_date FROM public.waseel_sbs_import_log wsil;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwwaseelsbsimportlog TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwwaseelsbsimportlog FROM report_user;
